name: Vinya Yoga and Wine Bar
notes: All 4 photos were legible printed menus (no plates/storefronts/drink lists). Two are different snapshots of the weekday menu (older vs newer revision) merged without duplicating identical items, keeping items unique to each (Brunch + Jars+Jars from the older photo; Meatball, Crabby Bowl, Chicken Mole, S'mores from the newer). A separate laminated Small Plates/Salads menu and a Happy Hour bites menu were also photographed; their wine/beer-by-the-glass lists were skipped as drink-only.
